metadata.name: ffmpeg
metadata.summary: Universal multimedia framework to decode, encode, transcode, mux, demux, stream, and filter audio and video

content.value: FFmpeg is the leading universal, open-source multimedia framework capable of decoding, encoding, transcoding, muxing, demuxing, streaming, filtering, and playing almost anything that humans and machines have created. It supports a vast range of legacy formats as well as the most cutting-edge audio and video standards.

Designed for maximum portability and high performance across platforms, this portable package bundles all necessary libraries and runtime components for dependable command-line processing on any Linux distribution.

items.value: Comprehensive decoding and encoding support for virtually all modern and legacy media formats
High-efficiency transcoding, multiplexing, and demultiplexing for audio and video streams
Extensive library of video and audio filters for rendering, post-processing, and audio enhancement
Real-time streaming and network broadcasting capabilities via multiple standard protocols
Fully self-contained portable packaging with no external dependencies required
